title: RemotePromptPairPipelineInput
description: Input for the remote_prompt_pair_pipeline tool. Mirrors RemoteStageRequest from schemas.py.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline run.

prompt_pair_id.description: Unique identifier for the prompt pair being evaluated.

system_prompt_id.description: Unique identifier for the system (positive) prompt.

system_prompt_text.description: Full text of the system (positive) prompt.

negative_prompt_id.description: Unique identifier for the negative prompt, or null if not used.

negative_prompt.description: Full text of the negative prompt, or null if not used.

dataset_root.description: Absolute path on the remote server to the dataset root directory.

output_root.description: Absolute path on the remote server where outputs will be written.

limit.description: Maximum number of samples to process (0 means all).

allow_partial.description: If true, a partial run (some failures) is still considered successful.
